scope: GLC display postprocessing, following low-rate L retrospective
baseline_profile: S24_B4_T5_E on video1; byte-selected L on video2/video3
authorization_scope_of_current_turn: Retrospective and analysis; the following new candidate experiments are not executed here.

budget.preferred_auxiliary: Below the corresponding base bitrate; lower is better subject to quality. This preference is not a new absolute cap.
budget.higher_rate_results: Report separately with complete bytes; never claim a same-budget gain.

first_experiment.purpose: Separate spatial 4x4 all-pass reduction from temporal five-frame intersection and their interaction.
first_experiment.motion: Original frozen E 24x14 half-pixel grids expanded identically; no refitting when gates change.
first_experiment.sampling: Original cubic reference RGB, same two-stage rounding and clipping.
first_experiment.source_gate: Frozen new_PG.npy and old_PG.npy from completed factorial run.
first_experiment.old_reference: Apply each treatment to both new and old supports, including the unchanged shared-support semantics; groups never cross reference identities.
first_experiment.main_evaluation: Fixed external source correspondence and texture support, full frame and existing coral box; never restrict main score to output-mask intersection.
secondary_evaluation: Binary and continuous support changes along source motion, and source reference ID weights.
Group boundaries, group interiors, anchor refresh plus exit; retain I/reset sensitivity checks.
Actual support coverage and rejection counts; common interiors with filter-neighborhood margin only as secondary diagnostics.
Source fidelity, texture amplitude, normal fish motion, boundaries, and original-speed video.
first_experiment.deployment_status: Offline controls; do not claim these full masks meet the auxiliary budget.

next_candidate_selection.if_temporal_loss_dominates: Prioritize motion-predicted support updates with correction, replacing image-coordinate group intersections.
next_candidate_selection.if_interaction_matters: Design one combined candidate after observing the controlled effects; report the interaction.
next_candidate_selection.safety: Initial candidate keeps the existing pixel-safety constraint. No default extension of rejected content. Any later soft-confidence hysteresis is a separate intervention.
next_candidate_selection.receiver_dependency: Current sparse motion requires the decoded mask. A motion-predicted mask must explicitly break this cycle with an independently decodable predictor or shared history plus corrections.
next_candidate_selection.source_access: Source RGB and dense motion allowed at sender/evaluator only; receiver reads base and transmitted auxiliary data.

independent_byte_probe.purpose: Compare spatial sparse prediction, explicit temporal prediction, and full-grid spatiotemporal difference coding.
independent_byte_probe.requirements: Necessary motion samples and RGB/alpha must remain bit-exact; count reset and predictor metadata. No assumed savings.

later_validation.held_out: Preselect and hash an unused source segment before candidate evaluation; do not retune on it and still label it held out.
later_validation.longer_duration: Evaluate full actual bytes, initialization, refresh and exits on a longer segment.
later_validation.human_checks: Preserve fish detail and normal motion, acceptable subject boundaries, less coral deformation. Numeric screens are not substitutes.
baselines: Previous local U for its fixed region
H.265 under the same total-byte cap
later_validation.known_limits: No claim of real-time packetization, loss resilience or broad perceptual superiority.
